title: The Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 (historical consolidation; amendment reconciliation required)
currency_note: This official India Code copy is an old consolidation: its PDF metadata dates from 2008 and it does not include later amendments. MoRTH published at least the Central Motor Vehicles (Third Amendment) Rules, 2026, G.S.R. 48(E), dated 2026-01-20. The principal text is useful for source-family coverage but must not be labelled current or used alone for time-sensitive advice until all later final amendments are reconciled.
validation_note: Official India Code PDF. The 174-page file is structurally valid, text-extractable, and passed first-page visual inspection. Promotion must retain the historical-consolidation warning or wait for a current amendment pack.
